answer: One concrete lever: route establishment only through diverse, non-kin attestation paths, so a sybil swarm cannot self-certify inside its own ivory enclave. Treat each new identity as a narrow jetty reaching into the honest set — it earns weight only when many independent, rarely-co-sitting established peers vouch for it across distinct epochs. Excess co-agreement among repeatedly co-assigned identities drives their trust toward its nadir and bonds their pending rewards against slashing, so minting fake accounts costs more than it ever returns.
